meta.title: Jorge Fuentes | Software Developer · Odoo
meta.description: Portfolio of Jorge Fuentes, Odoo and backend developer based in Chile. Custom modules, REST API integrations and web products, with a passion for games and AI.

hero.tagline: I build custom Odoo modules, integrations and automations, and ship web products end to end. On the side, I make video games and experiment with AI.

about.title: About me
paragraphs: I'm an Odoo developer at Sellside, where I build custom Odoo 18 modules with Python, OWL/JavaScript and PostgreSQL, design REST API integrations with other ERPs and automate data synchronization for enterprise clients.
I hold a Computer Programmer Analyst degree from Duoc UC and I'm currently completing a Computer Engineering degree at the same institution.
Beyond ERPs, I'm driven by video games and artificial intelligence: I'm building an anime football RPG from scratch in Unity 2D pixel art, and my long-term goal is to start my own game studio.
